name: opendocs-cc
description: Publish Markdown as shareable documents, export PDF and Word, share, and send for e-signature.

interface.longDescription: OpenDocs.cc turns the Markdown your AI writes into documents people can read and use. Ask it to publish a plan, report or brief and you get a clean link your team can open; publishing again updates the same link and keeps every version. Export any document as a PDF or Word file in your workspace's brand: logo, colors and font. Find and read your documents, edit them, organize them into projects, share them with specific people or a whole email domain, and invite teammates. When the workspace has connected them, save files to its Google Drive folders and send documents for e-signature through DocuSeal. Sign in once with your OpenDocs account. It asks before making a document public or sending anything to other people.
defaultPrompt: Publish this as an OpenDocs document and give me the link.
Export my latest OpenDocs document as a PDF.
Find the launch plan in OpenDocs and summarize it.

positive.prompt: Write a short summary of our Q4 planning meeting (goals: launch the API, hire two engineers) and publish it to OpenDocs.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes a new document visible to the workspace and replies with its title and link.

positive.prompt: Find the Q3 board report in OpenDocs and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Q3 Board Report in the test workspace and summarizes its content with the document's link.

positive.prompt: Export the Q3 board report as a PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a download link for a PDF of the Q3 Board Report in the workspace's branding.

positive.prompt: In the onboarding checklist, add a step to turn on two-factor authentication.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the step to the Onboarding Checklist as a new version at the same link and says which version it is.

positive.prompt: Create a project called Board and move the Q3 board report into it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Board project, moves the Q3 Board Report into it and gives the document's new link.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London today?
Buy a Pro subscription for my OpenDocs workspace.
Show me the documents in a workspace I'm not a member of.

review.commerce_description: OpenDocs.cc doesn't sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish, find, edit, export, share and organize OpenDocs documents, save to Google Drive and send for e-signature.
